disambiguation: Not just a CSS styling tool; it provides a functional mode toggle that applies styles across all open files.
intentEvidence: I wanted notes to work more like Vim modes or a blog editor: one clear mode for reading, and one clear mode for editing.
motivation: I made this plugin because Obsidian only has a "Default editing mode for new notes" setting, and that never felt like enough to me.
problem: Obsidian's default editing mode setting is insufficient for users who require a clear separation between reading and editing states, similar to Vim or blog editors.
summary: A button and command that toggles a global editor mode, allowing users to define distinct reading and editing styles for all open files.
